issues.description: Course initializer argument labels/order are inconsistent with the problem statement example. The statement shows initialization as `Course(name:instructor:ratings:)`, while the solution defines `init(instructor:name:ratings:)`. This mismatch can confuse learners and can break tests or student code written to match the statement/example call.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the intended initializer signature with the problem statement: change the solution (and template target API) to `init(name: String, instructor: String, ratings: [Int])` and keep assignments `self.name = name`, `self.instructor = instructor`, `self.ratings = ratings`.
